competition.description: 3D time-lapse microscopy cell detection, lineage linking, and division reconstruction.
competition.prediction_target: A cell graph with detections, temporal links, and division events; metric is adjusted edge Jaccard with a division component.
competition.models: DoG/Hungarian; U-Net + transformer + ILP; association MLP ranker; harmonic fusion; edge-stage TTA; controlled post-processing.
competition.standing: Ongoing; best public 0.915; five submission slots unused on 2026-08-15; final private/rank not available
competition.lesson: The live leaderboard rejects the clean direct-export expectation; keep the public association stack as baseline and separate model changes from inactive or unverified controls.
